intervals.note: netCi is an approximate interval, not a posterior credible interval. se_o/se_d are shrinkage-aware sandwich standard errors from the ridge fit, and the net SE combines them assuming independence, which the two coefficients of one player are not strictly. Tiers are therefore conservative in spirit but should not be read as exact posterior statements.

tiering.rule: players are grouped by netP into contiguous tiers; a player joins the current tier while his 95% interval overlaps that of the player who opened it, and opens a new tier when it does not
tiering.why: a ranked list implies distinctions the intervals do not support, so the constraint is encoded in this JSON rather than in the UI, where a styling change could silently restore ranks
